name: Instant Film
tagline: Square instant-camera snapshots with soft flash and dreamy color.
description: The charm of a shaken instant print: square frames, built-in flash, creamy highlights, faded color casts and the occasional light leak. House parties, beach days, birthday candles, snow days and campfires, perfect for a nostalgic grid or a profile picture.
